_comment: Optional starter FAQs. Run `npm run seed -w apps/server` once to load these into the `faqs` table (embeddings are generated automatically). After that, manage FAQs from the Admin Panel — this file is only a convenient bulk-import source, not read at request time.

faqs.question: What are your business hours?
faqs.answer: We're available Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm. Outside these hours you can still leave a message and we'll reply the next business day.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: You can reach our support team through this chat, or email support@example.com and we'll get back to you within one business day.

faqs.question: Do you offer refunds?
faqs.answer: Yes — we offer a full refund within 14 days of purchase if you're not satisfied. Contact support with your order number to start a refund.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're a remote-first company; please check the Contact page on our website for regional office details.
